response.justification: Despite a strong full-stack and open-source background, the candidate has minimal direct C++ experience beyond a brief role at National Instruments, and lacks demonstrated expertise in core requirements like message brokers, industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443), multi-threaded system design, or IoT protocols — all critical for this role.
strengths: Extensive experience in distributed systems and event-driven architectures via GISCollective and DLang projects.
Strong track record in mentoring, workshops, and promoting testing/coding best practices.
Proven ability to deliver complex software across diverse domains including embedded, web, and mobile.
concerns: C++ experience is outdated and minimal (only 6 months at NI), with no recent hands-on work.
No evidence of experience with IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial automation protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.).
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang; lacks demonstrated cloud-native C++ or MQTT/REST integration in industrial contexts.
